srFormula: R/S v10 role-reversal: ST=6M, LT=1Y, Super LT=2Y. For each horizon choose strongest pivot-low zone and strongest pivot-high zone by score=touches*3+avgReactionPct*1.2+recency*1.5. Zones do not disappear after price crosses them: support-origin above price is Broken S→R; resistance-origin below price is Breakout R→S. Cluster radius 1%, avoid duplicate zones within 2%.
srDisplayLimit: 6 auditable S/R levels: one support and one resistance for ST/LT/Super LT.
legacySrSideFixed: R/S side fixed by current close: above price = resistance, below price = support.
trendlineFormula: Trendline v3: ST last 6 months + LT last 1 year + Super LT last 2 years; each horizon has 1 support trend and 1 resistance trend.
trendlineDisplayLimit: ST Support/Resistance Trend, LT Support/Resistance Trend, Super LT Support/Resistance Trend
srLegend: Green=active support; red=active resistance; orange=broken support acting as retest resistance; cyan=breakout resistance acting as retest support.
